_note: Hand-tuned layer on top of the scraped brand.json (sergedenimes.com, Shopify). Run: python3 tools/build_brand.py --rebuild sergedenimes. The catalogue is now 100% jewellery (Rings 130, Necklaces 101, Bracelets 36, Earrings 25 + gift card; IG bio '925 Sterling Silver Jewellery'), so categories and copy are jewellery-only. Hero = the homepage's own craft video (re-encoded by the generator). Hand-picked images in assets/brand/ are crops of the site's own imagery: the homepage 'BEST SELLERS' hero, the 'ARMOUR / NOW LIVE' banner, a wide crop of the best-sellers campaign shot (rings), and the Redeemer (Anniversary) campaign image. Logos are the site's header SVG wordmark (the generator picked the search icon).

returns.summary: Return within 30 days of receiving your order through our returns portal, which also handles size swaps and return labels. Sale items: 14 days, store credit only. For hygiene reasons we can't accept change-of-mind returns on earrings or ring sizers. UK labels are free; a £3 handling fee is deducted from refunds, exchanges are free.

_rewards: No public loyalty programme page (a LoyaltyLion script is loaded on the site, but no rewards page exists: /pages/rewards and /pages/loyalty 404, nothing in the menus or footer). The Account rewards card is kept as an illustrative app concept (as yelir) and its fine print says so.
_discount: The site's announcement bar offers 10% off your first order for signing up (code emailed). The app pop-up mirrors 10% with the placeholder code APP10.

copy.about: Founded in 2011 by Oliver Proudlock, Serge DeNimes found its home in jewellery in 2017. Every piece is designed in London, made from 925 sterling silver and hallmarked in the UK. Four collections a year, each with its own story to tell.

_instagram: Collected in a browser from the brand's Instagram profile on 2026-10-11 (pinned posts excluded; profile/collaborator-path URLs normalised to /p/<code>/ or /reel/<code>/). Thumbnails: assets/ig/N.jpg, square-cropped, max 600px.
_sizes: Ring sizes from the variants (UK letter / US number, as labelled on the site). The generator's size groups only cover clothing letters and waists, so the ring group is set here; it drives the saved size, the 'in my size' filter and PDP pre-select.
_hero: Hero video = the homepage's craft clip (bd7b46…, 720p transcode; no public original upload). The source is only 5.5s, so the generator made a 4.8s cross-faded loop; that loop is played twice in assets/hero.mp4/.webm (9.7s, same H.264 CRF 23 / VP9 CRF 34 settings, no audio, faststart) to meet the README's 8–12s loop length.
